title: Checklist anchor: dashboard-top, settings-page and custom-anchor each resolve to a rendered slot or a defined fallback
description: The checklist slot honours the elicited checklist-anchor with a runtime clause per option. `dashboard-top` mounts the checklist at the top of the dashboard route provided by application-dashboard and refuses the mount (a WCAG 3.3.1 refusal announced on the settings surface) when application-dashboard is not applied. `settings-page` mounts the checklist at the settings route provided by application-account-settings and behaves as `dashboard-top` regarding refusal when the settings surface is unavailable. `custom-anchor` resolves an elicited CSS selector against the live DOM at load: on resolution the checklist mounts inside the resolved element with a default collapsed state (a <details> element with data-role=onboarding-tour-checklist and open=false); when the selector resolves to nothing or to an invisible or clipped element, the checklist mounts at the settings route as a fallback and the console log carries data-error=CHECKLIST_ANCHOR_UNRESOLVED naming the selector. In every branch, the checklist suppresses entirely when neither the dashboard nor the settings surface is applied and no usable custom anchor is set.
rationale: The elicit offers three checklist anchors but the shipped requirement covered dashboard-top and settings-page only. A project that chose custom-anchor inherited unspecified behaviour: no requirement described the default collapse state or what happens when the selector resolves to nothing. Requiring a per-option clause makes the fallback and the refusal observable.
